sections.title: Scope MLOps to your stage, not to a vendor diagram

blocks.heading: Start with the fastest-ROI component
paragraphs: Experiment tracking typically delivers the fastest return at the lowest implementation cost — hours recovered every week from reproducibility work. For teams with no MLOps today, we usually start here.

blocks.heading: MLflow or cloud-native?
paragraphs: Cloud-native MLOps (SageMaker, Vertex AI) reduces engineering overhead and integrates with managed services; MLflow is cloud-agnostic with broad community support. We model total cost of ownership for your usage patterns before recommending one.

blocks.heading: Designed for your maintenance capacity
paragraphs: Managed cloud MLOps needs less ongoing maintenance than self-hosted open-source stacks. We design for the platform engineering capacity your team realistically has.

sections.title: MLOps services pricing reference

items.question: How much do MLOps services cost?
items.answer: $20,000–$250,000 depending on scope. The most common enterprise engagement — experiment tracking, a model registry and basic CI/CD for ML — runs $40,000–$80,000; a full platform with drift monitoring and automated retraining runs $80,000–$250,000.

items.question: How long does MLOps implementation take?
Does MLOps cost scale with the number of models?
items.answer: Some components scale with model count (pipeline configuration per model); others are largely fixed (tracking server, serving infrastructure). We estimate the incremental per-model cost during architecture design.

items.question: Can you take over existing MLOps that isn't working?
items.answer: Yes. MLOps audits and remediation are a specific engagement type: we diagnose what is failing and either remediate or propose a targeted rebuild.

items.question: Do we need dedicated platform engineers to maintain MLOps?
items.answer: Managed cloud MLOps (SageMaker, Vertex AI) requires less ongoing maintenance than self-hosted stacks. We design for the maintenance capacity your team actually has.

sections.heading: Make your models reproducible, monitored and easy to release
sections.text: Tell us how many models you run and where releases or accuracy break down. An ML engineer will reply within one business day with a recommended MLOps scope and budget range.
